description: Bill an accepted offer. Required: offer_id. The lines are COPIED, so a later edit of the offer cannot change what was billed, and the offer is marked accepted. An offer that already has an invoice refuses unless force=true. Optional: title, intro, due_days, payment_note.

force.description: true bills the offer even if it already has an invoice

intro.description: Introductory text printed above the positions

payment_note.description: Payment information block (e.g. IBAN) printed on the invoice

name: invoice_from_offer
